These delicate white veils cover the face and spill out into long cloaks. Mourning veils are worn by mourners who hope to wield their grief as a weapon, using it to aid their allies and avenge their deaths.

Activate—Shed Tears r

Frequency once per day

Trigger An ally within 15 feet of you gains the dying condition

Effect You mourn your ally's fall. Your tears freeze into ice, chilling those around you. While your ally that triggered Shed Tears has the dying condition, any creature that starts its turn adjacent to you takes @Damage[2d6[cold]] damage with a @Check[fortitude|dc:27|basic|options:inflicts:slowed] save. If the creature critically fails, it's also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Slowed]{Slowed 1} for 1 round.
